english.title: Driver of a motor vehicle permit it to remain stationary on a clearway - local traffic order within Greater London
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ROAD AND LOCATION..), which had been designated a clearway by **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL TRAFFIC ORDER..), permitted the motor vehicle to remain stationary
english.legislation: Contrary to a Local Traffic Order and sections 6 and 8 of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
